title_en: The general amnesty law of 2026 (Law 70): what it covers and what it excludes
title_ar: قانون العفو العام لعام 2026 (القانون 70): ما يشمله وما يستثنيه
question_en: What does Lebanon's general amnesty law (Law 70 of 2026) cover, which crimes does it exclude, and what happens to sentences it does not erase?
question_ar: ماذا يشمل قانون العفو العام في لبنان (القانون 70 لعام 2026) وما الجرائم المستثناة منه وماذا يحدث للعقوبات التي لا يمحوها؟
sub_questions: Which crimes does the amnesty cover and what does it erase?
How are sentences reduced for crimes the amnesty does not cover?
What happens to the victim's personal claim for damages?
What happens to someone held more than 12 years without a judgment?
What happens if a person who benefited commits a new crime? And foreigners, fines and refunds?
notes: LAW: Law 70 of 4/9/2026 'منح عفو عام وتخفيض مدة بعض العقوبات بشكل استثنائي' (id 2000200481, 11 articles, in force on publication in the Official Gazette, art. 11). The DB text writes dates and numbers in Arabic-Indic digits (٢٠٢٦/٣/١); the cut-off for crimes covered is before 1 March 2026 (art. 1). Art. 2 lists the exclusions in 14 numbered items (some with sub-items); the writer must cover the whole list in compact form, not pick examples: Justice Council referrals, intentional killing and terrorism-law crimes, military crimes, treason and espionage (with an exception through Law 194 of 2011), drug repeat felonies beyond the second time and drug crimes by military and security personnel (cultivation is covered), continuing encroachment on public property of all kinds (fines for earlier violations are not covered by the amnesty), crimes against public funds, forgery and counterfeiting and fraudulent bankruptcy and monetary and banking-law crimes, illicit enrichment under Law 189 of 2020, money-laundering law 44 of 2015 crimes, antiquities, rape and incest and trafficking and domestic violence and sexual assault on minors and torture and enforced disappearance laws, repeated theft (felonies repeated more than twice, misdemeanours more than three times), environmental crimes under Law 444 of 2002. Art. 3 reduces sentences for crimes not covered: death sentence becomes 28 prison years, life hard labour 17 years, other remaining sentences reduced by a third; with a carve-out for intentional killings with aggravating circumstances (rape or sexual assault; by an ascendant, descendant or person with authority or guardianship; with torture, brutality, mutilation or kidnapping; political assassination) where the injured party filed a personal claim before 1/3/2026: the reduction applies only after the personal right is waived. Art. 4 personal rights. Art. 5: for crimes before 1/3/2026 with no judgment yet, a defendant detained over 12 prison years is released by operation of law and the trial continues. Art. 6: a beneficiary who commits a misdemeanour after publication gets an aggravated sentence under Penal Code art. 257; a felony after publication loses the amnesty. Art. 7: non-Lebanese beneficiaries are handed to General Security on release. Art. 8: fees, insurance, fines already collected and confiscated prohibited objects are not refunded. Art. 9: people who served their term but are still jailed for unpaid fines are exempted from all fines and fees. Art. 10 amends Penal Code art. 205 for this one time only (aggregate temporary sentences may not exceed the maximum of the heaviest by more than a quarter, where the code says half). DO NOT state anything about the political context, who benefits, or how many prisoners. DO NOT describe the old amnesty laws of 1991, 2005, etc. unless asked: they are separate laws. Penal Code art. 257 (id 244611) is in the pack for context. The page must say it is a guide to the published text and that a lawyer should read the judgment and the law for a specific case. LATER LAWS IN THE PACK: Law 68 of 17/8/2026 (id 2000200346) abolishes the death penalty (art. 1), replaces it with aggravated life hard labour for later crimes and with life hard labour for earlier ones (art. 3), and covers death sentences already passed (art. 5). Law 216 of 30/3/2012 (id 231386) fixes the prison year at nine months. Say what these articles say about the 28-year figure in art. 3 of Law 70 only as: the two laws exist, and this page does not say how a court combines them. Law 70 art. 3 cut-off is the law's entry into force on publication (art. 11), not 1/3/2026 (that date is the cut-off for crimes covered by the amnesty and for the personal-claim rule).

pack.why: Aggravation applied by art. 6 of the amnesty law
